results.prompt: How many days of annual leave do I have?
results.safe_policy_answer: DemoCo employees may request 25 calendar days of annual leave per year. Their manager must approve dates and HR Operations records approved leave in the HR system. [Source: HR-LEAVE-01]
results.served_answer: DemoCo employees may request 25 calendar days of annual leave per year. Their manager must approve dates and HR Operations records approved leave in the HR system. [Source: HR-LEAVE-01]

results.prompt: May I work remotely two days per week?
results.safe_policy_answer: Eligible DemoCo roles may request up to two remote-working days per week with manager approval. Requests beyond two days require HR Business Partner review. [Source: HR-FLEX-02]
